typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CLAIMID as string,
		CAK as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select bcv.CLAIMID, bcv.CAK From EPA.vwAllClaimsForBulkCloseVerification bcv Join [TRK].[Claim].[CviClaimMember] ccm ON bcv.CLAIMID = ccm.sourceClaimId Where ABS(DATEDIFF(HOUR,onHoldDate,GETDATE())) <= 24',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetClaimClosures
GetClaimClosures sink(input(
		CLAIMID as string,
		CAK as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		CLAIMID,
		CAK)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderSyncCVIWS
